ValidationRule.description: This rule will fire when Crop Type is blank for an SA quote line.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT( CONTAINS($Profile.Name,'Digital Hub')), ISBLANK( TEXT(PMC_CPQ_CropType__c )), OR( ISBLANK(PMC_CPQ_OpportunityLineItemId__c ), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(PMC_CPQ_OpportunityLineItemId__c )),NOT(ISNEW()))), NOT( PMC_CPQ_QuoteRegionExtractor__c = 'North America'), NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRBypassToggle__c )) )
